New Evidence Emerges in Delhi Gang Rape Case at Aastha Kunj

Police investigating a gang‑rape of a 17‑year‑old at Aastha Kunj Park, near the Kalkaaji temple in Delhi, have uncovered two new pieces of evidence. A video on an accused’s mobile phone shows the suspects threatening a couple, which police said links the incident to an older case. Investigators also found that the suspects washed their clothes after the assault to destroy evidence; the police have seized the garments and said they will seek a custody remand for the accused.
